2.msg: What? What's wrong? Did you lose your mommy?

3.msg: Ook... It's not that... (Sniffle) It was those mean monsters! They are always picking on me-ee-ee! They beat me up!

4.msg: Really? I'll make those jerks pay. Who did this to you?

5.msg: Ook... really? You'll punish those big meanies for me?

6.msg: Of course! I'll beat up 200 of them. I'll hit them so hard even their grandkids will know not to mess with Teeny White Monkey!

7.msg: Eek! Let's not go bananas. The big monsters that bullied me are around #b#h0##k's level. They're super strong. Will you still punish them for me? Really, ook? Really really?  \r\n #eMonsters Near Your Level are monsters between #r10 levels below and 20 levels above your own level#k

yes.0: Eekcellent! I'm gonna pick out tons of presents for you, #b#h0##k!
yes.1: Look, ook! I have Slot Expansion Coupons. Equip, Use, Set-up, Etc, and Storage Room tabs, Character Slots, you name it, ook!
yes.2: Ook. Where did I get all these? The bigger monsters made me clean up their Treasure Storage, and these were just lying around on the floor like garbage.
yes.3: Ook... what's wrong? One monster's trash, right? Don't worry, they're all yours now, #b#h0##k!
yes.4: Ook, ook-ook! Keep on punishing those big, bad monsters for me!
